items.title: Chester Zardis Interview, 1966-03-09
items.q: Yeah, but I didn't know his name but he was pretty good in his time. Well that's one of them what you call a tailgate man you know. But he was pretty nice and we'd get him in there to get him two trombones and maybe the whole band would be up there just having fun.

ctx.x: I guess that... Who that Buddy? Yeah. I know the old man Joe Petit lived across from Artesian Hall there when I knew him on Durbanon. Durbanon Street, yeah.

Yeah. Near St. Bernard. Yeah. Well he stayed there but most of the time he moved back on Zyga Street back of there, on Zyga and Miro. Back in there? That's where he died back there. Buddy didn't. No, the old man Petit, yeah. Joe Petit. Joe. And one time we had a trombone, just making them buck you know, right at the house there. You remember Ambrose? No, I don't think so. Well that's another trombone player, Ambrose. No, really not. Yeah, but I didn't know his name but he was pretty good in his time. Well that's…
Who did Ambrose? Yeah, do you remember?
